title: Hold a licence to take water
what: Take water from a proclaimed watercourse, wetland or underground source only under a right or a licence.

laws.title: Rights in Water and Irrigation Act 1914 (WA)

sources.title: Rights in Water and Irrigation Act 1914 (WA)
sources.quote: 5C. Taking of certain water without right or licence, offence (1) A person must not — (a) take water from any watercourse, wetland or underground water source to which this section applies;

reach.condition: if it takes water from a regulated river, aquifer or other water source, beyond basic landholder rights
